args.title: Juniper Labware: Freight Pricing This Quarter (3-bullet summary)
args.body:
- Newsletter (Juniper Labware): This week's topic is freight pricing this quarter, linking to the full article at blog.juniper.example/2026/freight.
- Article: Spot rates fell 9% while contract rates held steady, and fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- Companion piece: Shippers who split their volume across three carriers paid the least.
